PORT.description: The port on which the n8n web server listens.

DB_TYPE.description: The type of database engine used by n8n.

NODES_EXCLUDE.description: Array of default n8n nodes to exclude from loading.

DB_POSTGRESDB_HOST.description: The private network hostname of the connected Postgres database.

DB_POSTGRESDB_PORT.description: The network port used to communicate with the Postgres database.

DB_POSTGRESDB_USER.description: The database user credential for Postgres authentication.

DB_POSTGRESDB_DATABASE.description: The name of the database created inside Postgres for n8n.

DB_POSTGRESDB_PASSWORD.description: The database password credential for Postgres authentication.

N8N_RUNNERS_ENABLED.description: Enables task runners for offloading heavy workflow executions.

N8N_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED.description: Toggles anonymous diagnostic data reporting to n8n.

PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH.description: The explicit absolute path to the system Chromium binary inside the container.

N8N_COMMUNITY_PACKAGES_ENABLED.description: Controls whether community-contributed nodes can be installed.

PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD.description: Prevents local Node installations from downloading a redundant browser build.

N8N_VERSION_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED.description: Toggles UI notifications regarding new n8n version releases.

N8N_ENFORCE_SETTINGS_FILE_PERMISSIONS.description: Bypasses strict file system ownership checks inside Alpine Linux.
